$comment: Single source of truth for the four audiences. Imported by
UI/src/config/audiences.ts (Vite handles JSON natively) and read by
backend/audiences.py, so the prompt half and the UI half cannot drift.
The four ids are exactly the values the database check constraints allow
backend/tests/test_audiences.py asserts that, so adding a fifth id here
fails the suite instead of failing in the browser as 'save failed'.
affiliation_kind is a SIX-value enum and is a different concept: what a
person claims to be, not which experience they get. affiliations[] below
maps the two. 'staff' folds into faculty; 'applicant' and 'community' fold
into guest; guest itself declares no affiliation at all.

student.welcomeHeadline: What do you need help with today?
